Wheat___Leaf_Rust.symptoms: Chhote, gol se andakar narangi-bhure rang ke chhaley (pustules) patti ki upri satah par, patti ka peela padna aur sookhna.
Wheat___Leaf_Rust.solution: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L ya Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.25 ml/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Wheat___Leaf_Rust.precaution: Pratirodhi kismein jaise HD-2967, PBW-550 boyein. Der se buayi na karein aur nitrogen ka santulit prayog karein.

Wheat___Loose_Smut.symptoms: Baaliyon ki jagah kala powdery dhuen jaisa churna banna, baali ke dane puri tarah nasht ho jana.
Wheat___Loose_Smut.solution: Bimaar baaliyon ko polythene bag se dhak kar ukhad lein aur khet se door jalayein.
Wheat___Loose_Smut.precaution: Beej ko boyi se pehle Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS @ 2.5 g/kg se beej sanshodhan karein.

Wheat___Crown_Root_Rot.symptoms: Taane ke nichle hisse aur jado par bhure dhabbe, paudha peela padna aur khokhi baaliyan (whiteheads) banna.
Wheat___Crown_Root_Rot.solution: Jadon ke paas Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L ya Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L ka drenching karein.
Wheat___Crown_Root_Rot.precaution: Fasal chakr apnayein, gehri boyi se bachein aur khet mein paani rukne na dein.

Wheat___Healthy.symptoms: Pattiyan hari, chamakdar aur shuddh hain. Koi fafundi ya keet ke lakshan nahi hain.
Wheat___Healthy.solution: Kisi dawai ki zaroorat nahi hai. Samay par sinchai aur urea ki santulit matra dein.
Wheat___Healthy.precaution: Niyamit khet ki dekhbhal karein aur NPK (120:60:40) santulan banaye rakhein.

Rice___Bacterial_Blight.symptoms: Patti ke kinaroon se shuru hone wale peele-safed dhabbe jo lehredar bante hain, subah patti par baarik boondein aana.
Rice___Bacterial_Blight.solution: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.06 g/L (6g/100L) ka ghol chhidkein.
Rice___Bacterial_Blight.precaution: Khet se atirikt paani nikalein, bimaar khet ka paani doosre khet mein na jaane dein, nitrogen kam karein.

Rice___Blast.symptoms: Aankh ya naav ke aakar ke dhabbe jinke kinaray bhure aur beech mein dhusar (grey) hote hain.
Rice___Blast.solution: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L ya Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L ka turant chhidkaw karein.
Rice___Blast.precaution: Urea ki zyada khuraak na dein, raat mein nami zyada hone par saavdhani bartein.

Rice___Brown_Spot.symptoms: Patti par til ke daane jaise chhote gol/andakar bhure dhabbe jinke charo taraf peeli ring hoti hai.
Rice___Brown_Spot.solution: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2 g/L ya Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 2 ml/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Rice___Brown_Spot.precaution: Mitti mein potash aur zinc ki kami na hone dein. Niyamit roop se santulit khad dein.

Rice___Tungro.symptoms: Paudha bauna reh jana, pattiyaan peeli ya narangi rang ki ho jana, phoot (tillering) ruk jana.
Rice___Tungro.solution: Hare tiddi (Green Leafhopper) ke niyantran ke liye Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L chhidkein.
Rice___Tungro.precaution: Khet ke aas-paas se ghaas-phoos aur purani khunti hata dein, aage ki boyi sabke saath karein.

Tomato___Bacterial_Spot.symptoms: Pattiyon par chhote kaale-bhure chipchipaahat bhare dhabbe jinpar peeli aabhaar hoti hai, patti jhadna.
Tomato___Bacterial_Spot.solution: Copper Hydroxide 77% WP @ 2 g/L + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L milakar chhidkaw karein.
Tomato___Bacterial_Spot.precaution: Fawware (overhead) sinchai se bachein, katayi-chhantayi ke auzar saaf rakhein.

Tomato___Early_Blight.symptoms: Purani nichli pattiyon par gol chakradar (concentric target) dhabbe, patti ka peela hokar sukhna.
Tomato___Early_Blight.solution: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L ya Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Tomato___Early_Blight.precaution: Paudhe ko dande ka sahara (staking) dein taaki pattiyan zameen se na chhuwein, mulch lagayein.

Tomato___Late_Blight.symptoms: Bade aniyamit paani jaise geelapan liye dhabbe, patti ke niche safed rui jaisi fafundi, paudha tezi se jhulashna.
Tomato___Late_Blight.solution: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L ya Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L turant chhidkein.
Tomato___Late_Blight.precaution: Thand aur nami ke mausam mein niyamit jaanch karein, bimaar paudhe ukhad kar door phenk dein.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Patti ki upri satah par peele dhabbe aur nichli satah par zaituni-hare/bhoore makhmali fafund.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.solution: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L ya Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.precaution: Polyhouse ya khet mein hawa ka aawagaman behtar karein, nami 85% se kam rakhein.

Tomato___Mosaic_Virus.symptoms: Pattiyon par hare aur peele rang ke chitey (mottling), pattiyaan sikudna aur aenthan aana.
Tomato___Mosaic_Virus.solution: Virus ki seedhi dawai nahi hoti. Bimaar paudhe ukhad kar jala dein. Keet niyantran ke liye neem oil chhidkein.
Tomato___Mosaic_Virus.precaution: Haath saaf karke hi doosre paudhon ko chhuwein, tambaku ka sevan karke khet mein na jayein.

Tomato___Septoria_Leaf_Spot.symptoms: Chhote gol dhabbe jinke kinaray kaale-bhure aur beech ka hissa dhusar hota hai, baarik kaale bindu.
Tomato___Septoria_Leaf_Spot.solution: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L ya Chlorothalonil @ 2 g/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Tomato___Septoria_Leaf_Spot.precaution: Nichli bimaar pattiyan tor kar door phenkein, patti par paani na padne dein.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Bhure rang ke gol dhabbe jisme kinaroon par lakshya (target) jaise ghere bante hain.
Tomato___Target_Spot.solution: Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1 g/L ya Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Tomato___Target_Spot.precaution: Paudhon ke beech uchit doori rakhein, khet mein hawa aur dhoop aane dein.

Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Pattiyon ka upar ki taraf pyale jaisa mudna, patti ka peela padna, paudha thithurna aur phool girna.
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.solution: Safed makkhi (Whitefly) ke niyantran ke liye Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 0.5 g/L ya Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.4 g/L chhidkein.
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.precaution: Peele chipchipe card (Yellow sticky traps) 15-20 prati acre lagayein, 50-mesh jali ka upyog karein.

Tomato___Healthy.symptoms: Pattiyan swasth, hari aur sakriya hain. Paudha vikasit aur rog-mukt hai.
Tomato___Healthy.solution: Kisi chemical spray ki zaroorat nahi hai. Samay par pani aur kheti ki dekhbhal jaari rakhein.
Tomato___Healthy.precaution: Samay par compost aur 19:19:19 NPK ki matra dein.

Potato___Early_Blight.symptoms: Pattiyon par kaale-bhure chhalle numaa dhabbe, patti sukh kar papdi jaisi banna.
Potato___Early_Blight.solution: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L ya Propineb 70% WP @ 2 g/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Potato___Early_Blight.precaution: Fasal ko nitrogen aur potash ka santulit poshan dein, sham ke samay sinchai se bachein.

Potato___Late_Blight.symptoms: Geelapan liye bade kaale dhabbe, patti ke niche safed fafundi, badbu aana aur 3-4 din me fasal jhulashna.
Potato___Late_Blight.solution: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L ya Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L turant chhidkein.
Potato___Late_Blight.precaution: Bimari aane ki sambhavna par pehle hi Mancozeb ka chhidkaw karein, mitti chadha kar aalu ko dhakein.

Potato___Healthy.symptoms: Swasth hari pattiyaan, koi dhabba ya jhulsaahat nahi hai.
Potato___Healthy.solution: Chemical spray ki aavashyakta nahi hai. Routine sinchai banaye rakhein.
Potato___Healthy.precaution: Khet mein pani na theharne dein, niyamit roop se jaanch karte rahein.

Cotton___Alternaria_Leaf_Spot.symptoms: Pattiyon par gol bhure-baingani dhabbe jinke beech concentric rings banti hain, beech ka hissa gir jana.
Cotton___Alternaria_Leaf_Spot.solution: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L ya Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1 g/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Cotton___Alternaria_Leaf_Spot.precaution: Potash ki kami na hone dein, gir chuki bimaar pattiyon ko jala dein.

Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.local_disease: Kapas ka Jivanu Jhulsa / Kona Dhabba
Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.symptoms: Pattiyon ki naso ke beech konedar (angular) paani jaise dhabbe, taane par kaala rang (black arm).
Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.solution: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L ka ghol chhidkein.
Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.precaution: Beej boyi se pehle beej sanshodhan karein, bimaari pratirodhi kismein chunein.

Cotton___Fusarium_Wilt.symptoms: Pattiyon ki nasein peeli padna, patti ka murjhana, taane ke andar cheera lagane par bhura rang dikhna.
Cotton___Fusarium_Wilt.solution: Jadon ke paas Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L ka ghol dalein (drenching).
Cotton___Fusarium_Wilt.precaution: Neem khali @ 200 kg/acre dalein, fasal chakr mein anaaj wali fasalein lagayein.

Cotton___Healthy.symptoms: Hari chamakdar pattiyaan, mazboot shaakhayein aur tandurust fool/tende.
Cotton___Healthy.solution: Routine dekhbhal karein. NPK 19:19:19 ya micronutrient spray karein.
Cotton___Healthy.precaution: Peele/neele card lagakar ras-choosak keeto ki nigrani karein.

Soybean___Bacterial_Blight.symptoms: Chhote konedaar paani jaise dhabbe jo baad mein peele-bhure ho jaate hain aur pattiyaan fati fati lagti hain.
Soybean___Bacterial_Blight.solution: Copper Hydroxide 77% WP @ 2 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.05 g/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Soybean___Bacterial_Blight.precaution: Pattiyaan geeli hone par khet mein kaam na karein, do saal ka fasal chakr apnayein.

Soybean___Frogeye_Leaf_Spot.symptoms: Chhote gol dhabbe jinki baahar laal-bhuri border aur beech mein halka dhoosar rang hota hai.
Soybean___Frogeye_Leaf_Spot.solution: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L ka chhidkaw karein.
Soybean___Frogeye_Leaf_Spot.precaution: Pratirodhi beej boyein, fasal katayi ke baad aavshesh mitti mein dabba dein.

Soybean___Rust.symptoms: Nichli pattiyon par baarik bhure-laal daane jaise ubhaar (pustules), pattiyaan tezi se jhadna.
Soybean___Rust.solution: Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.25 ml/L ya Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L ka turant chhidkaw karein.
Soybean___Rust.precaution: Samay par boyi karein, ghanepan se bachein aur nichli pattiyon ki hafte mein jaanch karein.

Soybean___Healthy.symptoms: Hari-bhari tikhunti pattiyaan, tandurust vikas aur bina kisi daag ke faliyan.
Soybean___Healthy.solution: Kisi chemical dawai ki zaroorat nahi hai. Khet ko ghaas-mukt rakhein.
Soybean___Healthy.precaution: Khet mein jal-nikasi (drainage) achhi rakhein, beej sanshodhan zaroor karein.
